name: Dell TechDirect
description: Let agents look up warranty coverage for your Dell computers by service tag.
identity: An API key from your company's Dell TechDirect account, approved for the Warranty API.

setup.title: Request a Warranty API key
setup.body: Sign in to Dell TechDirect as your company's administrator, open APIs, and request access to the Warranty API. Dell reviews each request, which can take a few days.

setup.title: Copy the keys
setup.body: Once Dell approves the request, open APIs, then API Key Management, and copy the client ID and client secret of the production key.

capabilities.label: Look up warranties
capabilities.description: Read the model, ship date and warranty coverage of Dell computers by service tag.

revoke: In Dell TechDirect, open APIs, then API Key Management, and delete the key.
